(* an individual meets the substantial-presence election test if both subclauses hold *)
let meets_31_day_and_75_percent_test (individual : individual) (election_year : int) : bool =
  is_present_31_consecutive_days_in_election_year individual election_year &&
  is_present_75_percent_of_testing_period individual election_year

(* subclause I: present >= 31 consecutive days in election year *)
let is_present_31_consecutive_days_in_election_year (individual : individual) (election_year : int) : bool =
  consecutive_days_present_in_year individual election_year >= 31

(* subclause II: testing period = first day of 31-day run through last day of election year.
   up to 5 absence days in aggregate still count as present. *)
let is_present_75_percent_of_testing_period (individual : individual) (election_year : int) : bool =
  let testing_period = testing_period_of individual election_year in
  let days_in_period = days_in_testing_period testing_period in
  let actual_days_present = days_present_in_testing_period individual testing_period in
  let forgiven_absence_days =
    min (days_absent_in_testing_period individual testing_period) 5
  in
  let counted_days_present = actual_days_present + forgiven_absence_days in
  float_of_int counted_days_present >=. 0.75 *. float_of_int days_in_period
